note: United Arab Emirates: the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation issues a work permit for every hire; GCC citizens have their own, to further Gulf talent's mobility, and anyone brought from abroad for a specific task or time-bound project, as a performer's engagement, comes on the mission work permit (Gulf News, on MOHRE's twelve permits). Each emirate's performance permits for events (Dubai's, Abu Dhabi's) aren't modelled. No days of work without a permit are named.

sources.title: Gulf News, Working in the UAE? These are the 12 permits MoHRE says you must have
sources.said: Closely related is the mission work permit, intended for workers brought in from abroad to carry out a specific task or time-bound project. ... To support regional labour integration, there is also a work permit for UAE nationals and citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council countries, aimed at enhancing participation and mobility of Gulf talent within the UAE labour market.
